items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I got Don Byas, Billy Taylor piano, Tiny Grimes.

ctx.x: 53rd and Broadway and 51st and Sixth Avenue, took me about five minutes to walk over there, altogether it

was about 20 minutes, I could get over there, get in the uniform, do the two numbers and back. And so there, see, I was doing two Broadway shows at the same time. Two Broadway shows, and they were good shows because my name was on the playbill of each, see, and so I did two Broadway shows right at the same time and that's, I'm the one that replaced Benny. I did that for about four months and what I did I got men right off 52nd Street who were working on 52nd Street to do it, because all they had to do was come…

items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: So we go, and I think Buddy Tate was on there and Cozy Cole. We were takin' the place of Eubie Blake.

ctx.x: Was that the first time you were in Europe?

No, no -- So we go, and I think Buddy Tate was on there and Cozy Cole. We were takin' the place of Eubie Blake. So this guy asked us, 'Hey man, do me a favor, do this, I'll do this for you.' So when we come back, we stayed in Nice in France -- It's a place somethin' like Central Park. Paved's spotted all over, and you just wandered about. But it was much safer -- and it went on all day -- But there was a disagreement of me goin' somewhere with another agency over there, and there was strong words involved because…
How did you like playing in Europe?
